title: Brex - AI-powered corporate card and spend management for startups to enterprise
clean_text: Brex is an AI-powered spend platform combining a corporate charge card, cash management account (Brex Cash), expense management, travel, and bill pay for startups through enterprises. It is trusted by 1 in 3 venture-backed US startups, with customers including DoorDash, Coinbase, SeatGeek, Indeed, Allbirds, and Superhuman. The platform issues unlimited employee cards with auto-enforced spend controls, automated receipt capture and categorization, and integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite. Capital One announced its acquisition of Brex for $5.15 billion on January 22, 2026, with the deal expected to close mid-2026, which may change Brex's pricing and product priorities going forward.
